# Portfolio repository

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) for repository
instructions, architecture, and content conventions.
Read [STYLE_GUIDE.md](../STYLE_GUIDE.md) before changing layout or styling.
